subject: Entity documents, VAT certificate, and invoice clearance — NovaFleet
body:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novafleet.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: ap@novafleet.com
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork & outstanding invoice 2741

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. Our AP team pulled Invoice 2741 and flagged a couple of items before they can schedule payment:

- We don’t have a completed tax form on file that matches the invoice remit entity (company name on the invoice is Redwood Inference, Inc.). For US filings AP needs a W-9 if Redwood is US-based, or a W-8BEN-E if foreign.
- For our internal VAT reclaim process we also need a VAT registration certificate (we’re reclaiming VAT for the February services).
- Bank letter or ACH authorization page that matches the account used for payouts (to cross-check routing).

Can you send the completed forms or point me to a secure link? If you’re sending a W-8BEN-E, please confirm the EIN/foreign tax ID and the chapter 3 withholding status so we can classify for 1099/withholding.

We’re trying to close the payment by EOD Thursday (5/11); once AP has everything they’ll release payment.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Accounts Payable Specialist
NovaFleet Logistics

-----
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novafleet.com>
Cc: pr iya.natarajan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 14:30:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork & outstanding invoice 2741

Elena —

Thanks for the note and the clear checklist. Attaching the documents you requested: signed W-8BEN-E (Redwood elected foreign entity withholding classification), VAT certificate for the EU office that supplied the work, and the bank letter for ACH. Invoice 2741 is attached as well for reference.

A few clarifying points:
- Redwood Inference operates as Redwood Inference, Inc. (US parent) with a Redwood EU Services Ltd. branch — for the work in question the billed legal entity is Redwood EU Services Ltd. The attached W-8BEN-E is filled out for the EU entity; the invoice header reflects Redwood EU Services Ltd.
- Withholding: we are claiming chapter 3 status as a foreign corporation eligible for treaty benefits (line 14 filled — see exemption paragraph). If AP needs additional forms to prevent backup withholding please let me know; Marcus in Finance is on copy and can confirm tax classification.
- VAT reclaim: VAT certificate is a scanned copy from our EU finance team (Novafleet only needs this to complete reclaim; Redwood is not requesting refund).

If anything doesn’t match AP’s remit requirements, copy Marcus (marcus.lin@redwood.com) and Priya (priya.natarajan@redwood.com) and we’ll get it corrected right away.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: Novafleet_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf, Novafleet_VAT_Certificate.pdf, BankLetter_NovaFleet.pdf, Invoice_2741.pdf

-----Original Message-----
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: pr iya.natarajan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 14:33:45 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding paperwork & outstanding invoice 2741

Marcus / Priya —

Forwarding NovaFleet’s request — they need the W-8BEN-E, VAT cert and bank letter to clear Invoice 2741. I attached the forms we have. Can you validate the W-8BEN-E (foreign entity classification + treaty note) and confirm whether AP should mark this as 1099-exempt or if any backup withholding applies? Also confirm that the remit name on the invoice (Redwood EU Services Ltd.) is acceptable for NovaFleet’s AP process.

Happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Thanks,
Jonas

-----
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Elena Morales <elena.morales@novafleet.com>
Cc: pr iya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:08:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding paperwork & outstanding invoice 2741

Hi Elena, Jonas —

Thanks for sending these. I reviewed the W-8BEN-E and supporting docs this morning. Quick summary:

- W-8BEN-E: Completed and signed; tax ID for Redwood EU Services Ltd. (foreign TIN) is present, and the treaty benefit box is checked with supporting justificatory language in Part XX (we keep a copy on file). This supports non‑US withholding on the invoice amount.
- Invoice remit name: The invoice should be payable to Redwood EU Services Ltd. (see invoice header). If NovaFleet’s disbursement system requires a US entity, AP can pay Redwood Inference, Inc. but we will need to reconcile intercompany in our ledger — please let us know which legal name AP will push to the bank so we can prepare a remittance advice.
- VAT certificate: Matches the EU registration number on the invoice and covers the service period. Good for reclaim.
- Bank letter / ACH: Letter confirms the account name and routing and is stamped by our bank.

Action items for AP: please confirm whether your payment engine requires a US payee name or accepts the EU legal entity. If you can pay the EU entity directly we’re all set; if you must pay a US entity we’ll provide a corrected invoice header and post the intercompany adjustment.

I’ve attached the four files again for your AP intake: Novafleet_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf, Invoice_2741.pdf, Novafleet_VAT_Certificate.pdf, BankLetter_NovaFleet.pdf

If AP needs a W-9 instead (for Redwood Inference, Inc.) we can produce that quickly but it will change the remit name on the invoice.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0462

Attachments: Novafleet_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf, Invoice_2741.pdf, Novafleet_VAT_Certificate.pdf, BankLetter_NovaFleet.pdf

-----
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novafleet.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding paperwork & outstanding invoice 2741

Marcus / Jonas —

Thanks — AP confirmed they can process payment to Redwood EU Services Ltd. with the documents you provided. I scheduled the wire; expected settlement is EOD Monday 5/15.

For our records I uploaded the W-8BEN-E and VAT cert to our vendor portal and linked the payment to Invoice 2741. If anything changes I’ll send a remittance PDF.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on this.

Best,
Elena

---
[Note: attachments referenced above are scanned PDFs. If you need originals via DocuSign or a notarized bank letter please tell me and I’ll coordinate.]
